dimension_notes_summary.authorization_consistency: lev/ is a pure text-classification library (6 production files, 282 LOC): cli.py exposes a single argparse 'classify' subcommand, engine.py/loop.py/router.py are pure functions, types.py holds frozen

dimension_notes_summary.package_organization: The production package is a single flat directory lev/ with exactly 6 files (cli.py, engine.py, loop.py, router.py, types.py, __init__.py) totaling 282 LOC — below the <20-file small-project threshold
